historical_inputs_not_auto_promoted.rule: Historical scoped receipts may be rebound only by exact identity and scope; their union is not current C2/A2 admission.

closed_by_current_m5_receiving: Lawful public-key M5 receiving for all 6850 accepted atomic truth rows.
Non-forced unbanked M5 remains null and cannot qualify keep.
No hidden library identity/order, opponent hidden state or RNG was introduced by M5 receiving.

C2P01_pest_keep_bottom.requirement: Current exact Pest London keep decision plus physical bottom ordering over the finite reachable current predicate-vector bank for both play/draw starts.
historical_context: eight physical-land/typecycling bottom openings are narrow only

C2P02_monster_keep_bottom.requirement: Current exact Monster keep decision plus physical bottom ordering for both starts/seats over its finite reachable opening bank.
historical_context: two Monster physical-bottom cases are narrow only

C2P03_priority_payment.requirement: Rebind exact current reachable priority/action/payment variants; historical land, Crop, Map, Ent, response and combat cases remain scoped components only.

C2P04_pending_choices.requirement: Rebind exact current reachable pending choices including Stirrings/remainder, scry/surveil, Bog/optional targets and other offered groups; prove finite completeness.

C2P05_combat_postblock.requirement: Current pair whole-pilot attack/block/post-block priority coverage; historical two-seat combat baton is insufficient alone.

C2P06_hidden_invariance.requirement: Whole pair policy invariance under hidden-state permutations, not merely the lawful M5 seam.

C2P07_journal_replay.requirement: Source-bound durable claim/journal plus fresh replay for the exact pair package.

scope: C2P01 Pest London keep/bottom using current accepted vector+M5 receiving and a frozen raw-controller oracle without rerunning the 6850 raw M5 comparator
C2P02 Monster keep/bottom in the same prospective pair envelope
both play/draw starts and exact physical-card bottom identities
unknown non-forced Pest M5 remains fail closed
acceptance: finite bank is source-bound and completely enumerated before behavioral execution
raw oracle and lawful current actor agree on keep/mulligan and exact bottom identities for every declared row
no hidden information enters the lawful actor inputs
fail-closed unknowns are preserved rather than coerced
original XML/source/bank are preserved for one-time audit
prohibited: no pair/C2-A2 admission from a partial bank

admission_after_open_gates: Only a separately frozen/reviewed C2-A2 package may authorize any seed/allocation/claim/game action.
